title: Content Writer – Digital & B2B Content
description:
**Content Writer – Digital \& B2B Content**

**Company:** Madariz Impex Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kuzhivelippadi, Ernakulam, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **creative and skilled Content Writer** who can develop high\-quality content for our website, social media, marketing campaigns, SEO, and B2B business communication.

The ideal candidate should have strong **writing, research, SEO, storytelling, and creative communication skills** and be able to create content for different digital platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Write SEO\-friendly website content, landing pages, blogs, articles, and business content.
* Create engaging content for **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other platforms**.
* Develop content for digital marketing campaigns, advertisements, emails, and promotional materials.
* Write product, category, service, and B2B business\-related content.
* Conduct research and convert complex business/technical topics into simple, engaging content.
* Develop content calendars and plan content according to marketing objectives.
* Optimize existing content for SEO and search visibility.
* Collaborate with the **SEO, Digital Marketing, Design, and Video teams**.
* Maintain consistent brand tone, quality, and messaging.
* Use AI tools effectively for research, ideation, content development, and productivity while maintaining originality and quality.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent **English writing and communication skills**.
* Strong grammar, vocabulary, proofreading, and editing skills.
* **SEO Content Writing** and basic understanding of on\-page SEO.
* Keyword research and content optimization.
* Strong research and information\-gathering skills.
* Creative storytelling and headline writing.
* Social media content writing.
* Blog and long\-form content writing.
* Copywriting for advertisements and marketing campaigns.
* Ability to write for **B2B, technology, e\-commerce, and business audiences**.
* Basic understanding of Google Search, Search Console, and digital marketing.
* Knowledge of **AI content and productivity tools**.
* Ability to adapt writing style for websites, social media, advertisements, blogs, and business communication.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who is **creative, curious, detail\-oriented, research\-driven, and passionate about writing**.

Candidates with experience in **B2B, SaaS, technology, e\-commerce, digital marketing, or marketplace content** will have an added advantage.

**Portfolio / previous writing samples are preferred.**

**Apply now with your updated CV and writing portfolio/samples.**

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Attestation Documentation Executive
description:
Duties \& Responsibilities

* Handle document attestation, apostille, embassy legalization, and related documentation processes.
* Verify documents and ensure they meet the required guidelines and submission requirements.
* Coordinate with clients for document collection, verification, and processing.
* Prepare and organize documents for submission to embassies, government departments, and concerned authorities.
* Track applications and follow up to ensure timely completion and delivery.
* Handle client queries related to attestation and documentation procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of documents, applications, and client details.
* Make regular calls and follow\-ups with existing agencies and business partners.
* Maintain good relationships with existing agencies and identify opportunities for repeat business.
* Identify and approach new agencies, travel companies, and potential business partners to develop new business opportunities.
* Explain attestation services, procedures, and pricing to agencies and clients.
* Follow up on leads, quotations, and pending requirements to convert enquiries into business.
* Achieve assigned sales and business development targets.
* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure smooth processing of confirmed orders.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure the safe handling of clients' original documents.

Requirements \& Skills

* **1–2 years of relevant experience in attestation/documentation services is required.**
* Previous experience in **attestation, apostille, embassy legalization, or related documentation** will be preferred.
* Strong **sales and business development skills**.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to make regular calls and follow up with clients and agencies.
* Experience in **agency handling and relationship management**.
* Ability to generate new leads and develop new agency partnerships.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel and MS Office**.
* Ability to maintain lead sheets, sales reports, follow\-up sheets, and other Excel records.
* Good follow\-up, negotiation, and convincing skills.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated approach.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple clients and documentation processes simultaneously.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
